question: Approve the ideation design — posture (b), label the README brew block stable and point at the install guide for edge, is recommended — and rule on posture (a) vs (b) plus keep-or-drop of the contractlint drift arm (AC-2)?

artifacts.summary: Both postures shipped as apply-ready diffs against README.md@b04b3ef. Recommended (b): +7 net, 1 file — label the block stable, point at install.md for edge; (a) documents the edge cask inline (+9 net) but adds channel branching to a block that defers platform, and plants a third copy of channel commands (the stale-copy failure marketplace-readme-channel-model-repair just repaired). Spike run live: tap spellings verified equivalent, cask names+conflicts read from shipped .rb, edge binary self-selects its plugin (drops all claude-plugin lines from both diffs). Separable new mechanism flagged for necessity ruling: contractlint drift arm (AC-2, +30 net) guarding the tap-token divergence that exists today; drop it and the baseline is net +7/1 file. Estimate net +37 across 2 files, tolerance ±15; semantic changes: none.
